name: n019_res05_dur065_s2
purpose: Clean full rerun of the residual0.5 duration0.65 official E-VPC S with the BatchNorm terminal-batch fix applied from the start.

repair.cause: The original run failed because ECAPA BatchNorm received a final train batch of one sample.
repair.implementation: Copy the 17 MB code tree into /dev/shm, patch the copied VPC trainer to set train_loader_kwargs.drop_last=True, and redirect MIOpen cache to /dev/shm.
repair.scope: Only terminal one-sample training batches are dropped. Architecture, labels, epochs, optimizer, data, and AA evaluation remain unchanged.

decision_rule: Use the resulting S together with the already measured duration0.65 quality and W-NT metrics. Do not splice metrics from another suffix.
decision: Rejected. Duration0.65 lowers E-VPC S from 33.255% to 30.8555% while raising WER from 8.267% to 9.058%. Matching W-NT L does not compensate for the loss in timbral privacy and ASR quality.
